name: H.266 / VVC
next: Verify authoritative MP4 sample-entry and codec string registration, obtain compliant stream, then test browser playback.

name: MPEG-5 EVC
next: Identify a normative MIME/container mapping and a validated decodable reference file.

name: Motion JPEG / MJPEG
next: Test AVI and/or MOV MJPEG bitstreams using valid container MIME types; separate image/jpeg from video playback.

name: VC-1
next: Obtain a verified VC-1 sample in a suitable container; avoid treating generic video/quicktime as codec support.

name: Apple ProRes
next: Generate a small ProRes MOV (e.g., prores_ks), confirm codec tag, and test real HTML video playback in Safari and others.

name: Dirac / VC-2
next: Check Ogg Dirac mapping and create a valid sample; investigate codec-specific registered identifiers before support probes.

name: H.261
next: Create or source a valid containerized H.261 video; clarify modern browser paths rather than relying on old QuickTime documentation.

name: AVS2
next: Locate official bitstreams and valid web container mappings; verify that a codec-capable browser path exists.

name: AVS3
next: Locate reference files/decoders and container identifiers; check browser-native versus JS decoder options separately.

name: JPEG 2000 video
next: Determine whether Motion JPEG 2000 (MJ2) is supported in candidate browsers and source a valid test file.
